pages.description: Shop Bruder Tipping Trailer Removable Top at Clarkes of Cavan. A realistic Bruder farm toy for hands-on play. Available online in Ireland.
pages.ld_description:
Item Description

The gates of the tipping tandem axle trailer can be opened up on three sides. Also, the grain outlet slide can be opened and the top retaining gates are removable. A stabiliser ensures stability and tread tyres complete the picture. The tandem axle tipping trailer can be combined with all tractors of the Profi series (not included).
